snippet.title: Nemorsys – Trailer
snippet.description:
Nemorsys – Official Gameplay Trailer (New & Updated)

Step into the shadows. 
Nemorsys is a rogue-lite stealth action game where you embrace darkness itself to challenge a tyrant king.

Play as Kaelara, a young woman consumed by vengeance, and unleash the ancient spirit of shadow — the Nemorsys. Harness deadly shadow powers, outwit enemies through stealth and strategy, and fight your way through corrupted minions to bring down a fallen ruler.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3517930/Nemorsys/

Nemorsys will be available on PC, and a Kickstarter campaign will be coming soon.

Developed by Chaolys, a Québec indie game studio
Release Date: Q4 2026
